title: Software Engineer Intern
content: <p>Build robot fleet software.</p><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>Pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028</li><li>Experience with Python, C++ and Linux</li><li>Familiarity with k8s and Docker</li></ul><h3>Preferred</h3><ul><li>ROS, PyTorch</li></ul><p>We are unable to sponsor visas for this role.</p>
